title: The top-level goal 'rest three griefs (or earn the writ, or buy the Companies' road) to open Coldpass' has no visible numeric progress anywhere, unlike the per-hold verse quests which clearly show 'X/3'. After resolving Thornwold's grief the status screen's 'The Gray' entry just described the same overall condition again with no tally; I only learned a threshold had been crossed when buying the Companies' road announced pass access outright.
